notes: Gen 7 singles: Sylveon (Pixilate) uses Double Hit on Cofagrigus (Mummy). The first hit's contact turns Sylveon's ability into Mummy; the second hit stays Fairy (the type was set as the move started, so it still strikes the Ghost) but loses the 1.2 boost: Pixilate's `onBasePower` (`typeChangerBoosted === this.effect`) is a handler of the ability the user has at each hit (DESIGN.md R-M8-166)
